prose.summary: Reconciled source purposes: [1] Define leaf Projects as the executable work units while composite Projects organize and aggregate child work without becoming a second execution primitive. [2] Define leaf Projects as the executable work units while composite Projects organize/decompose work and derive state from explicit child/work semantics. [3] Define leaf Projects as executable work units while keeping execution evidence/results separate from the Project definition and from MeritCore evaluation.

semantics.authority_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Being a Project participant does not automatically bypass applicable authorization/policy. [2] Ability to view/participate in Project does not automatically grant execution-control authority.
semantics.causality_rule: Project parent-child structure does not itself define execution order; order/dependencies must be explicit.
semantics.completion_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Composite completion criteria are explicit and may depend on child outcomes according to declared policy. [2] Completion state follows explicit Project lifecycle/evidence policy.
semantics.composite_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Composite Project execution is expressed through its child/leaf Projects. [2] Composite Project coordinates/contains child Projects rather than representing hidden executable work by default.
semantics.definition_rule: Project definition and individual execution/activity evidence are separate identities/data.
semantics.event_rule: Execution transitions may emit explicit Events for automation/observability.
semantics.evidence_rule: Completion may produce evidence linked to that Project.
semantics.execution_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Leaf Project is the canonical executable work unit. [2] Execution/activity records reference the exact leaf Project identity.
semantics.hidden_work_rule: Executable work must not be hidden only in prose inside a composite Project.
semantics.leaf_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] A Project with no active executable child Projects is a leaf executable work unit. [2] Executable work unit is represented by a leaf Project.
semantics.merit_rule: Project execution may produce evidence consumed by MeritCore, but Project does not calculate MeritCore points/tiers.
semantics.result_rule: Work outputs/results reference the Project and retain their own semantic identity.
semantics.runner_rule: Automation used to perform Project work remains runner/operation execution and does not replace Project identity.
semantics.state_rule: Project execution state is explicit and separate from static definition.
semantics.tracking_rule: Work start/completion is tracked against explicit Project identity.
